title.narrative: UNDP: Economic dev. for peace, Colombia
UNDP: Ekonomisk utv. för fred, Colombia

description.narrative:
Projektet syftar till att främja lokal ekonomisk utveckling genom att stärka värdekedjor, främja inkluderande sysselsättning och skapa möjliggörande förutsättningar för fredsbyggande. Detta uppnås genom identifiering, aktivering och revitalisering av institutionella, miljömässiga, freds-, privata sektorns, finansiella och digitala ekosystem i territorier som historiskt har påverkats av väpnad konflikt.
För att uppnå detta mål fokuserar programmet på utvecklingen av fyra nyckelkomponenter: 1. Inkluderande värdekedjor, 2. Inkluderande sysselsättning, 3. Revitalisering av utvidgade fredsekosystem, 4. Konsolideringsmodell.
Det syftar till att tillgodose grundläggande behov såsom inkomstgenerering och att säkerställa värdighet, skydd och egenmakt. Med denna idé i åtanke kommer gradvisa lösningar att aktiveras för att driva lokal ekonomisk utveckling, vilket genererar territoriella transformationer som bidrar till ekonomisk inkludering, främst av kvinnor och ungdomar, och möjliggör ett bidrag till fredsbyggande.

The project aims to promote local economic development by strengthening value chains, fostering inclusive employment, and creating enabling conditions for peacebuilding. This is achieved through the identification, activation, and revitalization of institutional, environmental, peace, private sector, financial, and digital ecosystems in territories historically affected by armed conflict.
To achieve this goal, the program focuses on the development of four key components: 1. Inclusive Value Chains 2. Inclusive Employment 3. Revitalization of Expanded Peace Ecosystems and 4. Consolidation Model.
It aims to fulfill basic needs such as income generation and to ensure dignity, protection, and empowerment. With this idea in mind, gradual solutions will be activated to drive local economic development, generating territorial transformations that contribute to economic inclusion, primarily of women and youth, enabling a contribution to peacebuilding.

The primary objective of the project is to foster local economic development as a foundation for peacebuilding. This will be achieved by strengthening value chains, promoting inclusive employment, and implementing enabling actions across targeted territories to support the Peace Agreement and ongoing dialogues with various armed actors. The project will mobilize both private and institutional sectors, while also enhancing financial, digital, and peace ecosystems. A key component is an agile response mechanism designed to support coordinated initiatives aligned with peace dialogues and to foster trust-building between local communities and the private sector. These efforts aim to generate transformative territorial development, promote economic inclusion - particularly for women and youth - and ultimately contribute to sustainable peace.
To achieve this goal, the program focuses on the development of four key components:
1. Inclusive Value Chains. Strengthen and integrate local value chains to enhance the productivity and competitiveness of economic units in prioritized territories. 2. Inclusive Employment. Promote sustainable labor inclusion through coordinated interventions that enhance individual capacities, reduce structural barriers, and create effective conditions for labor market integration. 3. Revitalization of Expanded Peace Ecosystems. Create enabling conditions that contribute to the sustainability of local economic development through a Flexible Mechanism. It includes analyzing the needs to enhance opportunities for mobilizing resources to drive investment and addressing bottlenecks in implementing the Peace Agreement and ongoing negotiations. 4. Consolidation Model. Ensure the expansion, innovation, and continuous optimization of the economic development pathways based on Inclusive Value Chains and Inclusive Employment, strategies will be implemented to make these pathways more agile, efficient, and effective.

title.narrative: Decision on Contribution - Economic Development for Peacebulding UNDP

description.narrative:
Expected outcomes:
- Sustainability of Productive Units, ensuring that businesses and entrepreneurial projects integrated into value chains can maintain long-term viability, generating stable employment and fostering sustained economic growth in prioritized territories.
- Effective and context-adapted public management that warrants that governance policies and mechanisms at the territorial level facilitate the consolidation of inclusive and sustainable productive ecosystems while promoting institutional strengthening and participatory decision-making.
- Inclusive and transformative local markets, where strengthened and articulated productive units gain access to sustainable commercial networks, fostering economic diversification and equitable territorial development. This entails reducing structural barriers to market access, strengthening productive linkages, and implementing strategies that enable fair and competitive commercialization of goods and services, particularly for historically marginalized populations.
- Sustainable access and retention in the labor market create enabling conditions that allow individuals to enter and remain in formal, stable, dignified employment over time. This outcome ensures that participants access job opportunities and acquire the necessary tools to sustain employment and progress in their occupational trajectories. Labor sustainability is linked to stable contracts, access to labor rights, the possibility of improving working conditions, and resilience to adapt to evolving market dynamics.
- Inclusive local labor ecosystem enhanced through the coordination with private sector actors, the promotion of active labor policies, and reducing structural barriers such as lack of skills certifications, discrimination, job informality, and the exclusion of populations affected by conflict.
- Strengthened capacities of civil society and institutions to drive actions that fulfil the commitments outlined in the Final Peace Agreement and peace dialogues, creating the necessary enabling conditions to sustain the achievements in advancing socio-economic ecosystems.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
